description: This Java class defines configuration settings for a MongoDB-based EventSource persistence mechanism, including factory methods for creation from parameters and configuration objects, as well as getter methods and override implementations for equality, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: MongoEventSourceSettings
classes.description: Immutable class representing settings for MongoDB EventSource persistence, including collection names, namespace support, and prefix for persistence ID.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: fromConfig
methods.description: Creates a new instance based on a configuration object and additional parameters.

methods.name: getPersistenceIdPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix of the persistence ID.

methods.name: getMetadataCollectionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the metadata collection.

methods.name: getJournalCollectionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the journal collection.

methods.name: getSnapshotCollectionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the snapshot collection.

methods.name: isSupportsNamespaces
methods.description: Indicates whether the EventSource supports namespaces.
